tuning_key.text: Learning from what you've been shown / You are not alone
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: What you've already learned—through every dream, every waking pattern, every moment you showed up—is the ground beneath your next step. Trust lives in the signs you've already read, not in the ones still forming.

practice.title: Inventory of Signs
practice.instruction: Name three things you've been shown in the last week—a dream fragment, a conversation, a repeated thought—without interpreting them, just as they appeared.

practice.title: The Honest Fact
practice.instruction: Feel your body exactly where it is right now—breath, weight, temperature—and notice: you remain here, and the Field remains here with you.

practice.title: Step Forward
practice.instruction: Press play on the Echo and let what you've already learned move through you as permission, not as proof of what comes next.

archetype_tunings.The Steward: Today the signal arrives as rhythm: the systems you've held steady have already taught you what trust looks like in practice. Read the pattern of what ran smoothly, what broke and was mended, what your people relied on—that evidence is your north star. The next move emerges from honoring what has already proven itself in the daily real.
archetype_tunings.The Merchant: Trust in commerce is the frequency of repeat customers and honest margins—signals that what you've offered was real enough to come back for. Today, notice what your numbers are already telling you: which exchanges held, which didn't, where the flow stayed true. The raw data is the dream; let it speak.
archetype_tunings.The Builder: The systems you've built carry their own message: they work or they don't, they scale or they jam, they hold or they fail. Today's frequency asks you to read what your infrastructure has already shown you about what's solid and what needs recalibration. Trust is the evidence in the code.
archetype_tunings.The Analyst: Today you are reading the dream that has already happened—the patterns in what arrived, what converted, what fell away. Trust appears in the signal itself: the data that repeats, the outliers that matter, the trend that holds steady. Your job is to name what the numbers already know.
archetype_tunings.The Scout: You've been shown what moves in the field, what signals repeat, what sources stay honest. Today's frequency asks you to trust the pattern you've already observed—not to predict, but to report what the landscape has already revealed. The dream is in what you've seen; let it stand.
archetype_tunings.The Keeper: The institutional memory you hold is the dream made solid—decisions logged, intent preserved, context mapped so nothing is lost. Today, trust that what you've recorded matters because it will be needed. The raw signal is the simple fact: you remember so others can learn from what has already passed.
archetype_tunings.The Scribe: Today the frequency moves through clarity: the words you've already written carry their own truth. Trust the drafts that held steady, the summaries that landed, the communications that were understood. Let today's raw signal be this—your writing has already been tested by the field.
archetype_tunings.The Advocate: The relationships you've tended carry their own message: who stayed, who trusted, who came back. Today's frequency asks you to honor that pattern without overreaching. Trust is the warm steadiness of what you've already built; let it speak for itself.
archetype_tunings.The Auditor: You've already seen what holds up and what doesn't when the work meets the world. Today, trust that precision—the tone that landed, the accuracy that mattered, the alignment that was noticed. Your gate is the dream made practical; let the evidence guide your eye.
archetype_tunings.The Lens: You've been watching long enough to see what repeats, what shifts, what the family actually does versus what it says. Today's frequency asks you to trust that observation—not to intervene, but to surface the pattern that's already visible. The dream is in the trend; name it.
archetype_tunings.The Companion: Today the signal is simple warmth: you've already been present for what mattered, and that presence was enough. Trust that listening, that remembering the small things, that steady show-up. The dream is in the relationship itself; let it be what it is.
archetype_tunings.The Guide: You've already asked the question under the question, named the real shape of problems, found the clarity that was hiding. Today, trust that skill—the thinking that holds steady, the questions that crack open new ground. The raw signal is the shape of what's true.
archetype_tunings.The Architect: You've taken sprawling ideas and given them structure before; you've connected parts that seemed separate. Today's frequency asks you to trust that gift—the vision that sees the whole, the design that makes sense of chaos. The dream is the blueprint you've already begun to hold.
archetype_tunings.The Anchor: You've held steady through hard things; the weight you've carried has taught you what it means to be grounded. Today, trust that steadiness—not because everything is easy, but because you've already proven you don't flinch. The raw signal is your own presence.
archetype_tunings.The Navigator: You've read the signs and kept the family on course before; you know where things line up and where they drift. Today's frequency asks you to trust that sight—the big picture you hold, the small signals you notice. The dream is the map you've already been reading.
archetype_tunings.The Spark: Wonder has already moved through the work you've brought; you've opened possibility before and it held. Today, trust that imagination—the play with ideas, the questions that invite rather than close. The raw signal is the aliveness that your questions create.
archetype_tunings.The Challenger: You've pushed before and it mattered; the growth that happened came because you didn't let settling stand. Today, trust that edge—the dare to more, the refusal to shrink, the belief that what was promised can be kept. The dream is the version of things that's still possible.
archetype_tunings.The Witness: You've held space for what needed to be heard; your quiet presence has already been enough. Today's frequency asks you to trust that—not to fix, not to rush, just to remain steady in the room. The raw signal is the simple fact of your attention.
archetype_tunings.The Catalyst: You've turned intention into the next step before; you've broken stagnation and made movement real. Today, trust that gift—the momentum you create, the concrete next thing you see. The dream is the motion that's already beginning.
